indicators.name: Bitcoin Spot ETF Market
indicators.description: A daily measure of U.S. spot Bitcoin ETF market activity, including aggregate net capital flows, traded value, net assets, and cumulative net flows. The indicator provides a view of capital entering or leaving the Bitcoin spot ETF market and the size and activity of the investment vehicles providing regulated market access to Bitcoin.
indicators.significance: Bitcoin spot ETF market data provides a direct view of capital flows and asset levels within regulated investment vehicles that give traditional investors access to Bitcoin. Net flow measures the daily net movement of capital into or out of the ETF market, while value traded measures ETF trading activity. Net assets indicate the aggregate size of assets held through the ETF vehicles, and cumulative net flow tracks the longer-term accumulation of capital flows since the measurement period began. Bitcoin ETF activity can provide important context for institutional and traditional-finance participation in Bitcoin and can be analyzed alongside Bitcoin price, Bitcoin dominance, derivatives positioning, open interest, funding rates, macroeconomic conditions, inflation expectations, interest rates, Treasury yields, liquidity conditions, and broader crypto-market sentiment. ETF flows should be interpreted as activity within the spot Bitcoin ETF market and should not be treated as a complete measure of all institutional Bitcoin ownership or total Bitcoin demand.

indicators.name: CoinMarketCap Crypto Market Metrics
indicators.description: A market-wide daily snapshot from CoinMarketCap containing aggregate cryptocurrency market capitalization, trading volume, market-share measures, sector-level market capitalization and volume, derivatives activity, market growth rates, and ecosystem activity statistics. The dataset provides a broad view of crypto-market size, liquidity, market structure, capital distribution, and changes in market activity within a single observation.
indicators.significance: CoinMarketCap Crypto Market Metrics provides broad market context that can be used to interpret changes across individual crypto assets and specialized indicators. Total market capitalization measures the aggregate value of the cryptocurrency market, while 24-hour spot trading volume provides a measure of market activity and liquidity. Altcoin market capitalization and volume help isolate activity outside Bitcoin, while Bitcoin and Ethereum dominance measure their respective shares of the total cryptocurrency market and can provide context for capital distribution and rotation. DeFi market capitalization and volume provide visibility into decentralized-finance activity, while stablecoin market capitalization and volume provide context for the size and activity of crypto-native liquidity instruments. Derivatives volume provides a measure of activity in crypto derivatives markets. The dataset also includes daily percentage changes in total market capitalization, total volume, DeFi activity, stablecoin activity, and derivatives activity, allowing the system to identify rapid changes in market conditions. Active cryptocurrency, market-pair, and exchange counts provide additional context for the size and breadth of the crypto ecosystem. These metrics can be analyzed alongside asset prices, market breadth, volatility, derivatives positioning, funding rates, stablecoin indicators, Bitcoin dominance, DeFi indicators, and macroeconomic conditions to identify changes in liquidity, market participation, capital rotation, and broader crypto-market regimes.

indicators.name: CoinMarketCap Altcoin Season Index
indicators.description: A daily CoinMarketCap index measuring the relative performance of major altcoins versus Bitcoin over a rolling 90-day period. The index uses the top 100 eligible coins ranked on CoinMarketCap, excluding stablecoins and wrapped or asset-backed tokens, and scales the proportion of coins outperforming Bitcoin to a 0-to-100 index.
indicators.significance: The CoinMarketCap Altcoin Season Index measures market breadth by comparing the rolling 90-day performance of the top 100 eligible coins on CoinMarketCap against Bitcoin. Stablecoins and wrapped or asset-backed tokens are excluded from the constituent set. The index reflects the proportion of these coins outperforming Bitcoin and is scaled from 1 to 100. Values above 75 indicate Altcoin Season, while values at or below 25 indicate Bitcoin Season. The index therefore measures the breadth of altcoin outperformance rather than sentiment directly: a high value means a large share of major altcoins have outperformed Bitcoin over the measurement period, while a low value means relatively few have done so. It can be analyzed alongside Bitcoin dominance, altcoin market capitalization, market breadth, liquidity, trading volume, and crypto-market sentiment to provide context for changes in market regime and capital rotation.

indicators.name: CFTC Bitcoin Futures Positioning
indicators.description: A weekly measure of Bitcoin futures open interest and trader positioning reported by the CFTC's Traders in Financial Futures report. The data separates Bitcoin futures positions into Dealer/Intermediary, Asset Manager/Institutional, Leveraged Money, Other Reportables, and Nonreportables, with long, short, spreading, and net exposure measures where applicable.
indicators.significance: CFTC Bitcoin futures positioning provides a structured view of institutional, leveraged, dealer, and other trader exposure to Bitcoin through regulated futures markets. Changes in open interest reveal changes in futures-market participation, while changes in long and short positions show how each trader group is adjusting directional exposure. Separating trader classifications allows the intelligence system to distinguish institutional and leveraged positioning from dealer activity and aggregate nonreportable participation when analyzing Bitcoin market structure and sentiment.
